3118.title: Desktop host artifact generation fails after packaging
3118.rootCauseOneLine: Electron Builder omits the bb-app README while packaged host-artifact materialization unconditionally copies it.
3118.proposedFix: Explicitly include the bb-app README in the Electron desktop package and add a packaged-layout smoke test that generates the host artifact.
3118.caveats: The package and artifact service were reproduced twice; a real second-machine daemon restart was not exercised.
